title: Application updates
policy: Checks silently once every 24 hours. Finish tasks and close the case before updating. The app verifies the signature, exits, replaces its executable and restarts.
unconfigured: This build has no update signing public key. Download an official portable release manually.
manualFirst: This executable has no portable release metadata. Download an official release first.
confirmDescription: Finish tasks, release mounts and close the case first. The app downloads and verifies the update, exits, replaces itself and restarts. Only the application EXE changes; cases, evidence and settings are preserved.

errors.closeCase: Close the current case before updating.
errors.busy: Tasks, mounts or emulation sessions are still active. Finish them and retry.
errors.schema: This version changes the case database schema. Back up cases and follow the release notes to upgrade manually.
errors.signature: Signature or release metadata verification failed. Replacement was refused.
errors.network: Cannot reach the update source. Check the connection or download manually.
errors.recovery: An update is pending recovery. Restart the application before retrying.
errors.failed: Update failed. Your current program is preserved. Retry or download manually.
